label: Test coverage maintenance (coding agent, 30 min)
description: Git ff-only pull, then targeted tests for low-coverage areas. Project-Workspace im Dropdown wählen. Worker unter Admin → Interfaces aktivieren. Job zuerst disabled anlegen, dann enablen.

job.title: Coverage maintenance
job.instructions:
Scheduled test-coverage maintenance for THIS workspace only.

## Phase 0 — Git (required first)
1. coding_git_read: git status.
2. If working tree is NOT clean and not on agent/* branch: log to docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md and STOP.
3. coding_git_sync pull (ff-only). On failure: STOP.
4. Branch agent/coverage-MAINT (date in name). No push.

## Phase 1 — Measure
1. Read docs/CONVENTIONS.md or docs/COVERAGE.md if present.
2. Run coding_workspace_verify OR pytest with coverage via coding_bash.
3. List up to 5 lowest-coverage critical modules in docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md.

## Phase 2 — Tests (limits)
- Add or extend tests only for critical paths from inventory.
- Max 3 test files, max 12 new test cases.
- No production behavior changes except minimal testability fixes.

## Phase 3 — Close
1. Re-run verify/coverage command.
2. Update docs/MAINTENANCE_REPORT.md with results.
3. Short plain-text summary.

coding_workflow.prompt_preamble: Scheduled coverage maintenance. Do not add trivial or generated-file tests. Stop if git is not clean.
